title: Program Rate by Engagement Class for TimeBank Project Draws
content:
**Project class schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, the block hours of a group on a Major Project or Strategic Program engagement are multiplied by 0.9, an engagement of that size drawing block time at the program rate; those of a group on a Standard Project or Advanced Project engagement, by 0.95; those of a group on any other engagement, by 1. The class is the engagement class of the Professional Services Projects engagement whose statement of work the group is logged under.

| Engagement class | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Major Project, Strategic Program | 0.9 |
| Standard Project, Advanced Project | 0.95 |
| Assessment Engagement, Quick Start Project | 1 |

Hypothetical case: a group converting to 6.00 hours before this multiplier draws 5.40 hours on a Strategic Program and 5.70 hours on a Standard Project.
